title: Analysis of co-expression networks in Populus spp. under phosphate deficiency and aluminium toxicity
author: Thiago Bergamo Cardoso
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.6q7hdzn

steps.title: Download microarray datasets
steps.instruction: Retrieve the two microarray data sets from the NCBI GEO/ArrayExpress repositories using accession numbers GSE19297 and E‑MTAB‑3934.

steps.title: Process raw data in R
steps.instruction: Load the Affymetrix GeneChip Poplar genome array (v1.1) CEL files into R (version 3.3.2) and analyse them with the “affy” package: normalize probes with the Bioconductor rma() function, obtain log₂ expression values, and keep only transcripts that are present in all replicates (as determined by the mas5calls() function) in at least one condition. Save the resulting matrix (see Supplementary table S1.xlsx).

steps.title: Annotate probes with Blastx
steps.instruction: Use the Blastx tool to align each probe sequence against the Populus trichocarpa CDS database; record the best hits and e‑values in the file anotacao.xlsx.

steps.title: Compute BCV and plot MDS
steps.instruction: For each treatment, calculate the biological coefficient of variability (BCV) with the EdgeR package and generate a multidimensional scaling (MDS) plot to visualise sample proximity.

steps.title: Calculate Spearman correlations
steps.instruction: For every pair of genes, compute the Spearman correlation coefficient (ρ). For each ρ, calculate a two‑tailed p‑value using the Excel formula P = IDIST{ABS[ r /SQRT({1‑ r * r }/{ n‑2})],[ n‑2],2}, where n is the number of samples and r is the observed ρ.

steps.title: Filter strong, significant correlations
steps.instruction: Retain only gene pairs with ρ ≥ 0.8 and a p‑value that meets the significance criterion described above.

steps.title: Calculate stress‑regulation coefficients
steps.instruction: For aluminium stress libraries: compute the mean of the three biological replicates for each gene, then divide each mean by the corresponding mean from the control library (same exposure time). For phosphate libraries: compute the mean of the three replicates, then (i) divide the medium‑phosphate library mean by the high‑phosphate library mean, and (ii) divide the low‑phosphate library mean by the high‑phosphate library mean. These ratios represent the regulation coefficient for each gene.

steps.title: Classify regulation direction
steps.instruction: Label genes with a regulation coefficient > 1 as positively regulated and those with a coefficient < 1 as negatively regulated (filters recorded in Supplementary table S2.xlsx).

steps.title: Predict transcription factors
steps.instruction: For each gene in the co‑expression networks, submit the corresponding Populus trichocarpa protein sequence to the PlantTFDB TF prediction server; record the predicted transcription‑factor identity and family.

steps.title: Perform GO enrichment
steps.instruction: Run Blast2GO on the protein set of each network to identify enriched Gene Ontology (GO) categories; store the results in Supplementary table S3.xlsx.

steps.title: Assemble final co‑expression network
steps.instruction: Include only genes that (i) satisfy the ρ ≥ 0.8 and significant‑p‑value filter, (ii) have a regulation coefficient classified as positive or negative, and (iii) are predicted as transcription factors by PlantTFDB. Export the resulting network to the file Network_080_DE_Al_P_pvalue.csv.
